title: Corinthians and Palmeiras Join The Guardian's List of Prospects
seoTitle: Corinthians & Palmeiras on The Guardian's Prospect List
subtitle: Iago Machado and Eduardo Conceição Highlighted Among World's Top 60 Prospects
excerpt: The British publication The Guardian unveiled a list of 60 young talents, featuring players from Corinthians and Palmeiras, sparking considerable excitement.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Guardian published on Tuesday a list of 60 young athletes considered the biggest prospects in world football born in 2009. Among the selected names are Iago Machado, from Corinthians, and Eduardo Conceição, from Palmeiras, bringing the classic rivalry into focus in sports discussions.

The Chosen Players

Iago Machado, a defender who completed his entire youth training at Corinthians, is already part of the main squad and debuted against Flamengo in September. According to the publication, the value to try and sign him from the club exceeds R$ 630 million.

Eduardo Conceição, a forward from Palmeiras' U-20 team, also trains with the professional squad. His contract runs until 2029 and includes a release clause of 100 million euros, equivalent to R$ 580 million, with an expected revenue of up to R$ 300 million in case of a sale.

Impact on Negotiations

The values cited for both athletes reveal the importance clubs place on the commercial and sporting future of these young players. While Palmeiras expects to receive a significant amount for Conceição's eventual transfer, Corinthians has a high asking price for any offer involving Machado.

Fan Reaction

The presence of representatives from Corinthians and Palmeiras on the same list of prospects intensifies the rivalry between the two fan bases, who are now closely following the development of these athletes in the youth categories and their first professional games.

Career Prospects

Both players have already represented Brazil's youth national teams, reinforcing the expectation that they could join the senior national team in the future, should they maintain their performance in the youth categories and as professionals.

Conclusion

With Iago Machado and Eduardo Conceição among the world's 60 biggest prospects, the rivalry between Corinthians and Palmeiras gains a new chapter, now centered on the talents that could define the next generation of Brazilian football.

With information from ge.
